svg.title: BS 546 5 A socket-outlet (female), mating face
svg.desc: Schematic front view with the earth hole at the top. Larger earth hole above the centre; neutral hole lower left, line hole lower right. Rings are female contacts. Proportions follow 19.1 mm between line and neutral centres, 22.2 mm from the earth hole to the line-neutral axis, and pin diameters of 5.1 mm and 7.1 mm.
